candidate: Shandong University Longshan — Phase 1 Data Centre and Research Platform

selected_geometry.precision: Representative point inside the community-mapped property named for the Phase 1 mixed-use project. It does not identify the northern compute rooms, an individual building footprint, an entrance, an active-work boundary, the whole university campus or an official surveyed parcel.
selected_geometry.identity_review: The original Jinan survey tender identifies the exact Shandong University Longshan Digital Support Research Platform Phase 1 project in Zhangqiu. The original national procurement notice explicitly identifies the data-centre machine-room design at that same campus and jointly names Shandong University and CSCEC Fifth Bureau as tenderers. The September contractor article uses a short project title but its rendering title names the exact Phase 1 EPC scope, and its body explicitly separates north compute rooms from south research offices. OSM way 1551159473 bears the exact official project title; the neighbouring Digital Innovation Centre is separately mapped as way 1551159472 and is excluded. The selected map feature is therefore a named project property, not an address geocode or an inferred whole-university marker. No claim is made that a primary planning map independently validates the OSM boundary.
selected_geometry.uncertainty_reason: The community map gives no measured horizontal accuracy or verified displacement to the northern machine-room portion.

point_method: Calculate the midpoint of longitude and latitude extrema from the native OSM vector vertices using Decimal, then verify containment by ray casting. This is a bounding-box midpoint, not a polygon centroid. No imagery georeferencing, GCJ/BD conversion or primary-map alignment performed.
